 News School Holiday November 21, 2026: Will Schools Remain Closed on Saturday? Check State-Wise Updates
 By Pratyasha Chaturvedi Last Updated: Nov 20, 2026, 21:09 IST School Holiday November 21, 2026: Will Schools Remain Closed on Saturday? Check State-Wise Updates Register for Result Updates School students across India are checking whether schools will remain closed on Saturday, November 21, 2026, as several states continue to observe festive vacations and weather-related restrictions. The approaching weekend, along with Cyclone Akvan’s impact on parts of eastern India, has raised questions among parents about school operations. November 21, 2026 falls on Saturday. While there is no nationwide school holiday announced for the date, students in some states will continue to enjoy their scheduled Diwali vacations. Additionally, schools in selected districts of Odisha will remain closed due to the prevailing cyclonic weather conditions. 
 School Holiday November 21, 2026: Check State-Wise List 
 Given below are the school holidays for November 21, 2026. Check the complete state-wise list:- 
 State-Wise List 
 Reason 
 Delhi-NCR 
 Schools in Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad and Faridabad are expected to remain open unless local authorities or your school announces a closure. 
 Haryana 
 No statewide holiday has been announced yet. Schools are expected to remain open unless specified otherwise. 
 Uttar Pradesh  
 Schools are expected to stay open on November 21, 2026, unless otherwise announced by any local authorities. 
 Himachal Pradesh 
 Schools should follow their normal timetable, and no statewide holiday has been issued or confirmed. 
 Bihar  
 Schools are expected to follow regular timings; parents and students are advised to check the school’s official notice for last-minute changes. notice 
 Rajasthan 
 Schools are expected to remain open on November 21, 2026, as there is no official notice issued for a holiday. 
 Odisha Schools Closed Due to Cyclone Akvan 
 The Odisha government has ordered schools in six districts to remain closed from November 19 to November 21, 2026, as a precautionary measure amid Cyclone Akvan. The affected districts are Ganjam, Gajapati, Puri, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapara and Kandhamal. The closure applies to government, government-aided and private schools, along with Anganwadi centres.
